buildOk.detail: As shipped, `flutter build apk --release` FAILS on this network: thermion_dart's native-assets hook downloads Filament prebuilts from https://pub-c8b6266320924116aaddce03b5313c0a.r2.dev/filament-v1.69.1-android-release.zip and the TLS handshake is rejected (Dart: 'HandshakeException: Handshake error in client (OS Error: WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER(tls_record.cc:127))'; curl: 'tlsv1 alert protocol version'; same result inside and outside the tool sandbox while cloudflare.com/github.com work, so r2.dev itself looks blocked on this network). Workaround used (all in scratch): unmodified thermion_dart 0.5.0 via dependency_overrides path, its hook cache pre-seeded with google/filament v1.69.1 release archives (filament-v1.69.1-android-native.tgz, 49.6 MB; filament-v1.69.1-mac.tgz, 44.9 MB) plus libimageio.a(+libpng objects) and libtinyexr.a compiled from Filament v1.69.1 sources (the upstream archives do not ship them; thermion's TEngine.cpp includes imageio). thermion's bundled Filament headers are byte-identical to upstream 1.69.1, and the result linked and ran. Second blocker: ':thermion_flutter:checkReleaseAarMetadata' failed (plugin compileSdk 33 < 34 required) — fixed with the root Gradle snippet in this folder. After that: arm64 release APK builds (first build 43 s incl. ~30 s native C++ compile of 65 thermion sources; incremental 13-24 s). macOS release build also succeeded after raising the deployment target to 13.0.

measuredOn: macOS 26.5.2, Apple M1 Pro, release build, 2026-10-12 (proxy only). Android: not run (no device for this agent).
lines: Partial. (1) Filament line primitives exist: PrimitiveType.LINES / LINE_STRIP (thermion_dart lib/src/filament/src/interface/primitive.dart:5,7) via createGeometry (filament_app.dart:362) — but Filament has no line-width control, so these are 1-px hairlines (no AA beyond MSAA/FXAA). (2) Wide/AA edges: built-in Wireframe material (materials/wireframe.mat in the repo; WireframeMaterialInstance.setEdgeWidth(pixels) wireframe_material.dart:21; createWireframeMaterialInstance filament_app.dart:264) draws barycentric screen-space edges of EVERY triangle edge, needing loadGltf(rebuildVertices: true) (thermion_viewer_base.dart:155-172), which unwelds vertices (~3x vertex memory). (3) Silhouette outlines: highlight overlay / stencil highlight (view.dart:381,398; materials/edge_outline.mat) — selection outlines, not feature edges. Architectural feature/crease edges would have to be extracted offline and drawn either as 1-px LINES or as camera-facing quads expanded in a custom vertex shader.
customShaders: Yes, but offline-compiled. Material.createMaterial(Uint8List .filamat) (filament_app.dart:129) + MaterialInstance setParameterFloat/Float3/Float4/Mat4/Texture/Bool (material.dart:134-144) and setMaterialInstanceAt(entity, primitive) (filament_app.dart:270). Materials are Filament .mat files compiled with `matc` (ships in filament-v1.69.1-mac.tgz bin/matc) for opengl+metal targets; no runtime GLSL. Custom vertex attributes reach materials as CUSTOM0..7 (repo examples/assets/customattributes.mat) — but gltfio will not map glTF `_AO`-style attributes, so baked AO must come in as COLOR_0 or via createGeometry. Hatching = a custom unlit/lit .mat with screen-space or triplanar hatch in the fragment shader: feasible, not prototyped here.
sectionPlane: No built-in user clip plane anywhere in thermion's API (grep for clip plane/clipDistance finds only a Vulkan feature flag at native/src/vulkan/linux/LinuxVulkanUtils.cpp:452). A section plane must be a custom material that `discard`s fragments by world position against a plane uniform (getWorldPosition() in the fragment block) — applied to every primitive via setMaterialInstanceAt, plus a cap/hatch fill trick (stencil ops are exposed: material.dart:147-166). Feasible, not built-in.
depthBuffer: Yes. Always-on depth buffer; per-material depth write/test/func (material.dart:131-133), default render target DEPTH24_STENCIL8 (thermion_flutter options.dart:57), linear_depth/depth_sampler materials in repo, stencil enable on View (view.dart:313). SSAO: View.setAmbientOcclusionOptions(AmbientOcclusionOptions{radius, power, intensity, quality, bentNormals, ssct...}) (view.dart:64-93, 425) — Filament's SAO + SSCT; also shadows (PCF/VSM), fog, bloom, tone mapping, MSAA/FXAA/TAA (view.dart:311-326,416).
vulkan: Filament itself does NOT use Vulkan on Android in thermion: _resolveBackend() returns OPENGL for Android and throws 'Vulkan is only supported on Windows and Linux' if requested (thermion_flutter lib/src/platform/src/thermion_flutter_plugin_native.dart:103-131). Flutter's compositor can still be Impeller Vulkan: Filament renders off-thread into an Android SurfaceTexture (default) or SurfaceProducer (ThermionFlutterPlugin.kt:125-143) shown with a Flutter Texture widget (texture_widget_builder.dart:9) — external texture, not a platform view. Compatibility with Impeller Vulkan on the reference phone: unverified (no device). Plugin comment: SurfaceProducer is needed for premultiplied alpha under Impeller; SurfaceTexture is the default for opaque views.
gles: Yes — Filament's Android backend is OpenGL ES (EGL + GLESv3 linked, hook/build.dart Android branch ~l.262-275); requires a GLES 3.0 device. Compositing works with either Impeller backend in principle (texture registry); not verified on device.

risks: Build depends on a single maintainer's Cloudflare R2 bucket (r2.dev) that is NOT reachable from this (owner's) network; no checksum pinning, no mirror, downloads written into the shared pub cache. Every CI runner and developer machine needs that host.
Workaround builds are linked against upstream google/filament binaries plus hand-built imageio/png/tinyexr — workable but unsupported; any Filament version bump in thermion repeats this.
Bus factor 1 (nmfisher ~95% of human commits); 0.x API with ongoing churn; 278 commits/90 days means fast-moving, not frozen.
Android plugin Gradle is stale (compileSdk 33, AGP 7.3.0 / Kotlin 1.7.10 buildscript) — breaks out of the box on Flutter 3.47 / AGP 9 and drags ~101 MB of legacy Gradle artifacts on first build.

Android path is Filament OpenGL ES only (no Vulkan), rendered off-thread into a SurfaceTexture and composited by Flutter as an external texture: one extra copy/sample per frame, frame pacing driven by AChoreographer + Dart round trip; ImageReader/SurfaceProducer path documented as slower on some devices. Unverified on the reference phone.
APK +6.76 MB per ABI for the engine (libthermion_dart.so) — arm64 only measured; a fat APK with armeabi-v7a/x86_64 would add roughly that per ABI (untested).

gltfio rejects custom glTF attributes such as `_AO`: the asset pipeline must emit COLOR_0 (or build geometry via createGeometry). Default lighting without IBL renders unlit faces black; a KTX IBL/skybox asset is needed for acceptable shading (more APK bytes).
Native compile of 65 C++ sources in the hook on every clean build (~30 s on M1 Pro per ABI).
Startup: createViewer ~100-135 ms on M1 Pro (engine + render thread + swapchain + texture); expect several times that on a mid-range phone (unmeasured).
Custom materials need the offline `matc` compiler matching Filament 1.69.1; material binaries must be rebuilt when thermion bumps Filament.
